Capex plan for the following year: JPY 40,000 million, mainly Taiyo Yuden itself (Tamamura plant, Yawatabara plant, R&D Center etc.; mainly capacitor production and R&D equipment) JPY 12,000 million; TAIYO YUDEN (PHILIPPINES), INC. quarterly_data.quarter: Taiyo Yuden annual securities report: FY2026 (06-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Medium-term Management Plan 2030 (succeeds Medium-term Management Plan 2025, whose final year was the fiscal year ended March 2026; first year is the company's fiscal 2026, the year beginning April 2026, and final year its fiscal 2030): the company aims to raise the share of sales from its focus markets (automotive and IT infrastructure/industrial equipment) to 60% and plans capital expenditure of about JPY 270 billion over five years for continuous capacity expansion to meet growing demand. Management expects electronic-component demand in automotive and IT infrastructure/industrial equipment to grow, and states that AI servers in particular, with higher equipment performance and higher-density mounting, are expected to require large numbers of small, high-performance cutting-edge components. Strategy: further grow MLCCs, its main business, and strengthen inductors as a second pillar; continue domestic and overseas capacity expansion, build distributed production and use AI to improve production efficiency.
quarterly_data.figure: Focus-market sales share target 60%; capex about JPY 270 billion over five years (MTP 2030)

quarterly_data.quarter: Taiyo Yuden annual securities report: FY2026 (06-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D expenses were JPY 14,474 million in FY2026. For automotive (electrification) and IT infrastructure such as data centers whose performance is rising with AI, the company focuses on small, high-performance as well as large-size, high-voltage cutting-edge and high-reliability products. Capacitors: smaller, thinner, higher-capacitance MLCCs plus high-reliability large-size, high-voltage MLCCs whose applications are expanding, by advancing dielectric materials, thin-layer/high-capacitance and ultra-small production technology. Inductors: small, thin, high-current parts plus large, high-reliability parts mainly for automotive and IT infrastructure, through metal magnetic materials and winding/multilayer process technology. Also conductive polymer hybrid aluminum electrolytic capacitors for the focus markets.
